payload.outcome: RESOLVED by the new check:diff-integrity gate. TWO FINDINGS. (1) NOTHING NEEDED RESTORING: d1485d6e8 is not an ancestor of main and never was — it lived only on refs/pull/2481/head. PR #2481 squash-merged as e16d5f66d, whose diff is two src/components files; tests/ui-smoke.spec.ts is not in the merged diff at all, because the branch's later 'Merge branch main' commit 31f41450a took main's blob. Verified by blob hash (d1485d6e8:tests/ui-smoke.spec.ts = fe61672b2, the corrupt one; pr/2481/head = e16d5f66d = e16d5f66d^ = eb501f19e, main's, unaffected) and by title-set diff: all 89 test cases present at d1485d6e8^ are on main today, one renamed by dc15d0c69 (the review-due source-only row now keeps the overdue detail behind the evidence-gaps chip), plus one added by 07df3f6d5. main is at 90 cases / 6,194 lines. (2) THE COMMIT CONTAINED NO RECOVERABLE INTENT: its 4 insertions were not code but a file-reading tool's own truncation banner written back as file content — a warning line naming the original token count, a total-output-lines line, and a splice scar where an ellipsis marker reporting tens of thousands of elided tokens was joined mid-token into what should have been TypeScript. The file did not parse, so Playwright would have failed to load the spec rather than run 8 tests; this row's premise that a gutted suite 'goes green trivially' did not hold for this particular corruption, though it holds for any truncation that happens to leave valid syntax, which is what the new gate is calibrated for. The intended work landed separately as 47af5819c. GUARD: check:diff-integrity counts test cases from the TypeScript AST (a grep counts the RegExp test method and keeps counting commented-out tests), measured in aggregate across changed test files (25%) and per surviving file (50%, 10-case floor), against the merge base with origin/main so several small commits cannot slide under the threshold one at a time; plus a second rule rejecting any added line carrying a tool truncation banner, in any file, which covers the same failure landing in src/. Deliberate reductions are recorded in diff-integrity.json pinned to exact before/after counts, so an approval cannot cover a later, larger cut. Runs unconditionally in verify:cheap, verify:pr-local and CI static-pr. Calibrated on 300 real commits touching tests/: zero flagged; replayed against d1485d6e8 it fails all three signals.
